23	  // C# Rectangle.Intersects:仅边接触不算相交
24	  return a.x < b.x + b.w && b.x < a.x + a.w && a.y < b.y + b.h && b.y < a.y + a.h;
25	}
26	
27	function setBrick(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
28	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
29	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
30	  st.type[i] = BRICK; st.flags[i] = 1; st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0;
31	  // ★写砖必清坡位（cs:33760-33763 房连线列 / 33786-33788 房实心 / 33563-33566
32	  //   outerTempled / 33499-33503 templeCleaner else / 34161-34165+34181-34185 门框柱,
33	  //   全部六处 226 写入点都是 active(true)+type=226+liquid=0+slope(0)+halfBrick(false)
34	  //   五连写）。神庙壳压在丛林泥/洞穴坡面格上,不清坡 → 幻影坡幸存到 @52
35	  //   （W 批全图残余 351 格根源;与 TileRunner ClearSlope 同族写入语义）。
36	  st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;
37	}

39	/** SolidTile(i, j)（cs:70155）：active + tileSolid + !tileSolidTop + 非半砖 + slope 0。
40	 *  与 SolidTile2（cs:70178，祭坛锚点门用）差一个 tileSolidTop（平台）条件,勿合并。 */
41	function solidTileST(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
42	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
43	  const j = st.idx(x, y);
44	  if (!st.flags[j]) return false;
45	  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[j]];
46	  return !!d && d.solid && !d.platform && !st.half[j] && st.slope[j] === 0;
47	}

49	export function runTemplePass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
50	  const __cap = (globalThis as { __swWallCap?: (tag: string, gs: GenState, st: TileStore) => void }).__swWallCap;
51	  if (__cap) __cap('temple', gs, st);
52	  const tmMark = (s: string) => { const f = (globalThis as { __swTmMark?: (s: string) => void }).__swTmMark; if (f) f(s); };
53	  const { w, h } = st;
54	  const s = w / 4200;
55	  // 种子点(cs:15917-15992):y = Next(rockLayer, maxTilesY-600)(rockLayer 先钳 ≤ h-601);
56	  // x = ((NextDouble()*num3+0.1)*-dungeonSide+0.5)*w,num3 起 0.25,每 1e6 次失败
57	  // num3 = min(0.35, num3+0.05) 递增(cs:15978-15989);落点须为丛林草 60(cs:15972)。
58	  // num3==0.35 后再失败 10 轮放弃——★T7(cs:15992-16001):失败后原版**无条件**
59	  // 强制补建 makeTemple(maxTilesX - generatingDungeonPositionX, rockLayer + 100)
60	  // (remix 分支除外,本仓不支持),不缺席(见下方 sx<0 分支)。
61	  let sx = -1, sy = -1;
62	  {
63	    let band = 0.25, fails = 0, giveups = 0;
64	    for (;;) {
65	      let yTop = Math.floor(gs.rockLevel);
66	      const yBot = h - 600;
67	      if (yTop > yBot - 1) yTop = yBot - 1;
68	      const y = rng.int(yTop, yBot - 1);
69	      const x = Math.floor(((rng.next() * band + 0.1) * -gs.dungeonSide + 0.5) * w);
70	      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
71	        const i = st.idx(x, y);
72	        if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === JUNGLE_GRASS) { sx = x; sy = y; break; }
73	      }
74	      if (fails++ > 1000000) {
75	        if (band === 0.35 && ++giveups > 10) break;
76	        band = Math.min(0.35, band + 0.05);
77	        fails = 0;
78	      }
79	    }
80	  }
81	  // ★T7(cs:15992-16001):种子点失败时原版无条件强制补建——锚点
82	  //   (maxTilesX - generatingDungeonPositionX, rockLayer + 100)。此前直接
83	  //   return,异常种子/丛林草缺失时神庙整体缺席(祭坛+神庙箱+木刺全失)。
84	  if (sx < 0) {
85	    sx = st.w - gs.generatingDungeonPositionX;
86	    sy = Math.floor(gs.rockLevel) + 100;
87	  }
88	  tmMark('seed');
89	  // ---- 房间链(L17185-17231):重投至与全部旧房不相交;overlap 每次相交测试 1% 递增 ----
90	  let roomCount = rng.int(Math.max(2, Math.floor(10 * s)), Math.floor(16 * s) - 1);
91	  const rooms: Room[] = [];
92	  // ★cs:33596-33599 `int num3 = 1; if (genRand.Next(2) == 0) num3 = -1;`——
93	  //   Next(2)==0（sample<0.5）取 **-1**。曾写反（<0.5→+1）→ 房间链行进方向整体
94	  //   镜像（本种子神庙左移 58 格、房间集合全错 → #46 自债 typ28k/act15k/wal19k）
95	  let dir: 1 | -1 = rng.nextInt(2) === 0 ? -1 : 1;   // num2
96	  const startDir = dir;                   // num3
97	  let runLen = rng.int(1, 2);             // num8:行程阈值,每次换向后 +1
98	  let runStep = 0;                        // num9
99	  let cx = sx, cy = sy;                   // num6/num7:上一间中心
100	  for (let n = 0; n < roomCount; n++) {
101	    // ★cs:33636 `int num19 = -10;` 声明在 for-i **体内**——每房重置;曾跨房累积,
102	    //  房距越滚越宽+掷骰漂移(F2 代理附带发现)
103	    let overlap = -10;                    // num13
104	    runStep++;
105	    const last = n === roomCount - 1;
106	    let rect: Room = { x: cx, y: cy, w: 0, h: 0 };
107	    let newDir = dir;
108	    let rx = cx, ry = cy;
109	    let ok = false;
110	    for (let t = 0; t < 5000 && !ok; t++) {
111	      let rw = rng.int(25, 49);
112	      let rh = Math.min(rng.int(20, 34), rw);
113	      let baseY = cy;
114	      // ★T4(cs:33648-33659):UnderworldLayer 截断——num16+70 >= UnderworldLayer-10
115	      //   (本仓 UnderworldLayer = h-200,Main.cs:2863)命中时 num2=i+1(cs:33651)
116	      //   提前终结房间链并换大房间尺寸;cs:33677-33680 if(flag2) break 跳过相交
117	      //   重投。此前缺失,房间链可一路沉入地狱层。
118	      const uwCut = baseY + 70 >= (st.h - 200) - 10;
119	      if (last || uwCut) {

125	      }
126	      if (runStep > runLen) {

129	        rx = cx + rng.int(-5, 5);
130	        newDir = -dir;
131	      } else {

133	        ry = baseY + rng.int(-5, 5);
134	      }

136	      ok = true;
137	      // cs:33677-33680:if (flag2) break——地狱截断房直接采纳,跳过与旧房的相交重投
138	      if (uwCut) break;

141	        if (rng.int(0, 99) === 0) overlap++;
142	      }
143	    }
144	    rooms.push(rect);
145	    if (runStep > runLen) { runLen++; runStep = 1; }
146	    dir = newDir as 1 | -1;
147	    cx = rx; cy = ry;
148	  }
149	  // (原版无 rooms.length<3 闸——曾自制;T4 地狱截断后深种子世界可能截到 1-2 房,
150	  //  该闸会把整座神庙连同祭坛一起吞掉=花后进度断链,已删。下游仅相对下标,安全)
151	  tmMark('rooms');
152	  {
153	    const f = (globalThis as { __swTmRooms?: (r: Room[], sx: number, sy: number) => void }).__swTmRooms;
154	    if (f) f(rooms.map((r) => ({ ...r })), sx, sy);
155	  }
156	  // ---- 全房对实心砖连线(L17240-17278):四角组合插值走,每步铺整列砖 ----
157	  for (let a = 0; a < rooms.length; a++) {
158	    for (let b = 0; b < rooms.length; b++) {
159	      if (a === b) continue;
160	      for (let ea = 0; ea < 2; ea++) {
161	        for (let eb = 0; eb < 2; eb++) {
162	          let x1 = rooms[a].x + (ea === 1 ? rooms[a].w - 1 : 0);
163	          let y1 = rooms[a].y;
164	          let y1b = y1 + rooms[a].h;
165	          let x2 = rooms[b].x + (eb === 1 ? rooms[b].w - 1 : 0);
166	          let y2 = rooms[b].y;
167	          let y2b = y2 + rooms[b].h;
168	          let guard = 0;
169	          while ((x1 !== x2 || y1 !== y2 || y1b !== y2b) && guard++ < 3000) {
170	            if (x1 < x2) x1++;
171	            if (x1 > x2) x1--;
172	            if (y1 < y2) y1++;
173	            if (y1 > y2) y1--;
174	            if (y1b < y2b) y1b++;
175	            if (y1b > y2b) y1b--;
176	            for (let y = y1; y < y1b; y++) setBrick(st, x1, y);
177	          }
178	        }
179	      }
180	    }
181	  }
182	  // ---- 房间实心 + 双遍游走挖腔(L17280-17381)----
183	  for (const r of rooms) {
184	    for (let x = r.x; x < r.x + r.w; x++) {
185	      for (let y = r.y; y < r.y + r.h; y++) setBrick(st, x, y);
186	    }
187	    const l0 = r.x + rng.int(3, 7), r0 = r.x + r.w - rng.int(3, 7);
188	    const t0 = r.y + rng.int(3, 7), b0 = r.y + r.h - rng.int(3, 7);
189	    let l = l0, rr = r0, t = t0, b = b0;
190	    const midX = Math.floor((l0 + r0) / 2), midY = Math.floor((t0 + b0) / 2);
191	    const carveCell = (x: number, y: number) => {
192	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
193	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
194	      // ★cs:33852-33853 挖腔=active(false)+wall=87——type 保留为幽灵（原版直写
195	      //   失活从不清 type；清 0 会造 ~12k RAW typ 差）。挖腔前刚被 226 实心填充
196	      //   覆写，故此处幽灵恒 226；pather 走廊穿神庙外原石时幽灵=原石型
197	      st.flags[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = 87;
198	    };
199	    // 正向(列优先)
200	    for (let x = l0; x < r0; x++) {
201	      for (let y = t0; y < b0; y++) {
202	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) t += rng.int(-1, 1);
203	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) b += rng.int(-1, 1);
204	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) l += rng.int(-1, 1);
205	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) rr += rng.int(-1, 1);
206	        if (l < l0) l = l0;
207	        if (rr > r0) rr = r0;
208	        if (t < t0) t = t0;
209	        if (b > b0) b = b0;
210	        if (l > midX) l = midX;
211	        if (rr < midX) rr = midX;
212	        if (t > midY) t = midY;
213	        if (b < midY) b = midY;
214	        if (x >= l && x < rr && y >= t && y <= b) carveCell(x, y);
215	      }
216	    }
217	    // 反向(行优先)
218	    l = l0; rr = r0; t = t0; b = b0;
219	    for (let y = b0; y > t0; y--) {
220	      for (let x = r0; x > l0; x--) {
221	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) t += rng.int(-1, 1);
222	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) b += rng.int(-1, 1);
223	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) l += rng.int(-1, 1);
224	        if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) rr += rng.int(-1, 1);
225	        if (l < l0) l = l0;
226	        if (rr > r0) rr = r0;
227	        if (t < t0) t = t0;
228	        if (b > b0) b = b0;
229	        if (l > midX) l = midX;
230	        if (rr < midX) rr = midX;
231	        if (t > midY) t = midY;
232	        if (b < midY) b = midY;
233	        if (x >= l && x < rr && y >= t && y <= b) carveCell(x, y);
234	      }
235	    }
236	  }

238	  // ---- templePather 通道(L17392-17458):从种子游走穿各房,方块清空+墙 87 ----
239	  const pather = (px: number, py: number, destX: number, destY: number): [number, number] => {
240	    { const f = (globalThis as { __swTmPath?: (s: string) => void }).__swTmPath; if (f) f(`${px},${py}->${destX},${destY}`); }
241	    let x = px, y = py;
242	    let steps = rng.int(5, 19);
243	    const rad = rng.int(2, 4);
244	    while (steps > 0 && (x !== destX || y !== destY)) {
245	      steps--;
246	      if (x > destX) x--;
247	      if (x < destX) x++;
248	      if (y > destY) y--;
249	      if (y < destY) y++;
250	      for (let ix = x - rad; ix < x + rad; ix++) {
251	        for (let iy = y - rad; iy < y + rad; iy++) {
252	          if (!st.inBounds(ix, iy)) continue;
253	          const i = st.idx(ix, iy);
254	          st.flags[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = 87;   // cs:33541-33542 active(false)+wall=87，幽灵 type 保留
255	        }
256	      }
257	    }
258	    return [x, y];
259	  };
260	  let tpx = sx, tpy = sy;
261	  for (let n = 0; n < rooms.length; n++) {
262	    const r = rooms[n];
263	    const inner: Room = { x: r.x + 8, y: r.y + 8, w: Math.max(1, r.w - 16), h: Math.max(1, r.h - 16) };
264	    for (;;) {
265	      // ★cs:33944-33951：基础随机点两掷**无条件先掷**，末房再用中心±10 两掷覆写
266	      //   （4 掷/迭代）。曾只掷覆写 2 掷 → 每末房迭代 -2 掷（本种子 -10）→ 木刺段
267	      //   流位漂移（act 差 ~1k）
268	      let destX = rng.int(inner.x, inner.x + inner.w - 1);
269	      let destY = rng.int(inner.y, inner.y + inner.h - 1);
270	      if (n === rooms.length - 1) {
271	        destX = inner.x + Math.floor(inner.w / 2) + rng.int(-10, 9);
272	        destY = inner.y + Math.floor(inner.h / 2) + rng.int(-10, 9);
273	      }
274	      [tpx, tpy] = pather(tpx, tpy, destX, destY);
275	      if (tpx === destX && tpy === destY) break;
276	    }
277	    // 通向下一间的附加通道(2/3 概率近旁绕行,1/3 中点)
278	    if (n < rooms.length - 1) {
279	      const a = rooms[n], b2 = rooms[n + 1];
280	      let tx: number, ty: number;
281	      if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) {
282	        if (b2.y >= a.y + a.h) {

294	      } else {

335	  // ---- 入口隧道(L17500-17527):固定高度、固定间隔下沉,穿出神庙即停 ----
336	  const edir = -startDir;

function countingRng(seed: number) {
  const r = new RNG(seed);
  let n = 0;
  const wrap = {
    int: (a: number, b: number) => { n++; return r.int(a, b); },
    nextInt: (k: number) => { n++; return r.nextInt(k); },
    next: () => { n++; return r.next(); },
    vanilla: { next: () => { n++; return r.vanilla.next(); } },
    count: () => n,
  };
  return wrap as unknown as RNG & { count(): number };
}
